title: Map without the notice, /prueba-mapa/: no shrinking in a vertical Group, the details card, nothing to Google until «Ver mapa»
description: estrategia-web/map WITHOUT the cookie notice (consent off on purpose: the map must work without a notice). A map without an image: inside a vertical Group with overflow:hidden it does not shrink (the 03-10-2026 bug, fixed by inline-size: 100%); the details card in real text; no request to Google before the click, the embed after it. Google is answered by the runner (fulfill), nothing goes out. Read by browser-map-plain. It was step 1 of map.test.mjs (level 3) until 29-10-2026.

values.measure: (() => { const map = document.querySelector('.estrategia-web-map'); const wrap = document.createElement('div'); wrap.style.cssText = 'display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start'; map.before(wrap); wrap.append(map); map.style.overflow = 'hidden'; const caption = map.querySelector('.estrategia-web-map__caption'); if (caption) caption.style.position = 'absolute'; const frame = map.querySelector('.estrategia-web-map__frame'); const out = { figure: map.getBoundingClientRect().height, frame: frame.getBoundingClientRect().height }; if (caption) caption.style.position = ''; map.style.overflow = ''; wrap.replaceWith(map); return out; })()
